veranderings.rede: AWS comma: 'en' joins two sentences that each have their own subject and verb.

veranderings.voor: die Christelike geloof na ander dele van die wêreld gaan
veranderings.na: die Christelike geloof na ander dele van die wêreld versprei
veranderings.rede: A belief that 'gaan' somewhere is wooden; 'versprei' is the natural verb and matches 'sy geloof versprei' later in the lesson.

veranderings.blok: Handel en wins as 'n groot rede
veranderings.voor: het van ver in die Ooste gekom
veranderings.na: het van ver af uit die Ooste gekom
veranderings.rede: 'van ver in die Ooste gekom' is unidiomatic; 'van ver af uit die Ooste' is natural and matches 'uit die Ooste' in the next sentence.

veranderings.blok: Handel en wins as 'n groot rede
veranderings.rede: AWS comma: 'en' joins two sentences that each have their own subject and verb.

veranderings.blok: Hoekom peper in Europa so duur was
veranderings.voor: oor die see geneem en ander
veranderings.na: oor die see geneem, en ander
veranderings.rede: AWS comma: 'en' joins two sentences that each have their own subject and verb.

veranderings.blok: Hoekom peper in Europa so duur was
veranderings.voor: en so sy eie wins gevat
veranderings.na: en so sy eie wins gemaak
veranderings.rede: 'wins vat' echoes English 'take a profit'; in Afrikaans one 'maak' wins, as the lesson says elsewhere.

veranderings.voor: Die twee redes het nie apart geloop nie.
veranderings.na: Die twee redes het nie los van mekaar gestaan nie.
veranderings.rede: Reasons that 'apart loop' is wooden; 'los van mekaar staan' is the natural expression with the same meaning.
One pays 'vir' a journey, as the lesson itself says in the first and last blocks.

veranderings.voor: sy geloof versprei en hy wou
veranderings.na: sy geloof versprei, en hy wou
veranderings.rede: AWS comma: 'en' joins two sentences that each have their own subject and verb.
'help wys hoekom' is loose; 'help verduidelik hoekom' is clearer and keeps the meaning.

veranderings.voor: wat aan kos 'n sterk geur gee
veranderings.rede: 'geur gee' takes kos as indirect object without 'aan' here, and the shorter order reads more naturally.

beskerm_bedenkings.woord: Fyn stowwe soos sy het ook uit die Ooste gekom.
beskerm_bedenkings.rede: A Grade 6 reader may first read 'sy' as the pronoun 'she'; the wording is protected, so a person may wish to consider whether a form such as 'systof' or 'sy (die stof)' is acceptable to the fact check.
